learning_outcomes.text: Enable students to understand the basic principles of NC and CNC machines.
Provide information about the selection and use of NC machines.
Improve the ability to work as a team.
Improve the ability to write programs and gain practical experience on NC machines.

syllabus_topics: Development, definition and history of NC machines, application areas, feasibility, advantages and disadvantages of NC machines
General structure and operating principles of NC systems
Structure and design of CNC machines, features of elements and units, control of movements
bibliography: M. Akkurt “Bilgisayar Destekli Takım Tezgahları” 1. Baskı, Birsen Yay. 1996
H. Eskicioğlu “Basic Principles of Numerically Controlled Machine Tools” METU,1997
W. Luggen “Fundamental of Numerical Control” Delmar Pub., 1988
Weekly lecture notes to be distributed to students
